name: PHL 1677 = LP 758-18 = NLTT 51769 (40-pc DA)
published_label: Huang+2026 ApJS 284 72 'white dwarf oscillator' (TESS 135.487 c/d, 39.5 ppt); Gaia DR3 vari_classifier best class 'WD' (0.61); Jestin+2026 unclassified 'FAR'; Lin+2026 (arXiv:2608.19493) 21.26-min compact-binary candidate
conflicting_evidence: DA, Teff 7914 K, logg 8.39 (Tremblay+2020; GF21): 2.5-3 kK below the ZZ Ceti red edge; my ZTF DR fold: P=637.7118 s, semi-amp 4.7% g / 3.4% r, one coherent sinusoid over 2547 d (FAP 1e-102, g and r); no power at P/2 or 2P; neighbours within 63 arcsec are >=2 mag fainter
literature_status: variability published (Jestin 2026, Lin 2026, Huang 2026); Lin+2026 already argue ellipsoidal is impossible and rotation viable; nobody reports a magnetic field
verdict: not a pulsator; rotating (magnetic/spotted?) WD candidate with P=637.7 s; novelty low (signal and rotation alternative published)
